remainingCasesReportedToRoot.case: Mark an already-read visible row unread. It was never in seenIds, so the new observer can immediately mark it read again. Explicit manual unread needs an observer exemption.

Change filter or refresh while automatic read acknowledgment is in flight. Cleanup marks stopped, successful PATCH returns without publishing, and pre-added seenIds may prevent retry; confirm badge/list eventually reconcile.
Folded repeat toggle performs separate patch/load calls. Verify a partial failure stops or remains visible rather than being overwritten by a later success.
Read a personal notification while two tabs select different teams. Personal rows contribute to both badges, but exact-org broadcast matching currently refreshes only one.
Two inbox tabs in the same team: one changes read state. Shell badge receives broadcast but inbox list has no subscriber, so visible row state may remain stale.
